_readme: Help directory. Every number below was verified against the operator's or government's own site on 2026-10-14. Numbers that could not be confirmed on a first-party source are deliberately absent. `verified` records when the operator's own page confirmed it. `mode` controls which help-mode tab a card appears under: me | other | both.
_notes: Help directory. Every number was checked against the operator's or government's own site on 2026-10-14; nothing here was taken from a forum or a directory. 'operator' names who actually answers the phone, because a coarse official/not-official flag would mislead: SADAG, Lifeline, AA and NA are all non-profits. SADAG reported its SMS shortcodes down for maintenance in Sept 2026, so SMS is always secondary to a voice line, never the only route. There is no 24hr Christian pastoral crisis line in South Africa - do not invent one. Numbers not confirmed on a first-party source are deliberately absent.
